meta.title: Improve retain performance
meta.body_summary: Refactor Array::retain in builtin/array.mbt to cache length and element access, avoiding repeated method calls in loop.

core_change_summary.description: In builtin/array.mbt, refactored Array::retain to cache the array length in a local variable len and cache the element at index i via `let item = self.unsafe_get(i)` before passing to filter, and set only if true, avoiding repeated method calls within the loop.
change_trajectory: Single commit: Optimize Array::retain loop, modifying the loop to cache length and element access.
